tools.name: search_sirlero
tools.description: Search Sirlero’s public catalog of AI services, editorial stories, and writers. Returns the first ten matching titles, summaries, and source URLs.

tools.name: read_sirlero_page
tools.description: Read the full Markdown representation of a published Sirlero page. Use the canonical URL returned by search_sirlero. Only URLs in the published catalog can be read.

tools.name: next_sirlero_results
tools.description: Read the next page of a Sirlero catalog search when more than ten results match. Use the original query and the next_cursor from the preceding result page. Stop when next_cursor is null.
